pinTitle: 4 Hip Stretches That Actually Improve Cross-Legged Sitting
pinDescription: Limited hip mobility from tight adductors, hip flexors, and external rotators makes cross-legged sitting uncomfortable. These four stretches—butterfly, 90/90, low lunge, and pigeon—target the muscle groups that restrict hip rotation and abduction. Includes how often to stretch for real progress and what to expect over time.
